userMessage: Build a site for Atelier North, a luxury streetwear boutique in Milan, Italy. We sell limited drops, lookbook collections, and in-store styling appointments. Hero should feel editorial and fashion-forward, not food or restaurant vibes. CTAs: Shop collection, Book styling, Visit showroom on Via della Moda.

design.layout: clean grid with large imagery, ample white space, and elegant typography

visual_assets.hero_keywords: fashion editorial, luxury streetwear, Milan boutique, minimalistic, sophisticated
visual_assets.imagery_style: fashion photography, editorial style, urban luxury

notes: Use black and gold accent to evoke luxury and exclusivity.
Typography uses serif for headings to feel editorial and sans-serif for body for readability.
Hero uses a large fashion editorial photo with subtle dark overlay and bold CTAs.
Navigation includes Shop, Lookbook, Styling, Visit sections.
CTAs: Shop collection, Book styling, Visit showroom.

public_site.style_contract: All customer pages use a black and gold palette with Didot serif headings and Helvetica Neue body text, consistent button styles with gold accent and minimalistic layout.

visual_brief.copy_tone: editorial, confident, minimal; collection and craft
